The draw for a day uses the pool of the latest entry of this kind that was appended before the ledger entry listing that day's record and is anchored in a Bitcoin block at or below that entry's block. The pool is the JSON on the pool_canonical line; its sha256 is pool_sha256. Procedure: https://github.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/horizon-shield/blob/main/workers/hs-ledger/nenrin/witness-enroll-v0/PROCEDURE.md
Establishes: that this pool existed no later than the block this entry is anchored to.
Does not establish: that anyone in the pool will answer a draw, or anything about their answers.
